annotations.title: Research a topic across YouTube videos

description: Search YouTube for a topic and return the transcripts of the top videos in one call, each with its title, channel, and link, so you can compare what several creators say. Timestamps are kept so answers can cite moments. Costs 1 credit per transcript returned (captions only; videos without captions are skipped). Use upload_date for recent coverage.
